comparisons.name: pane-help-light
comparisons.description: The help button of the Bluetooth pane, Aqua. The question mark is drawn for the library on the measured ink box, so its outline is part of the score.

comparisons.name: pane-help-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As pane-help-light with the question mark masked, to score the measured bezel alone at half the colour distance.

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The help button held down with the mouse, Aqua.

pixels.note: pressed fill: the shared pressed bezel, --mac-bezel-fill-pressed, #f0f0f0 (spec: tokens.md, inferred). The help-button page of the spec infers a darker #e5e5e5; the two pages disagree and no screenshot settles it, so this pixel holds the component to the token sheet, not to that page
disabled fill: the bezel at half opacity over the page (spec: help-button, States, inferred from the measured disabled push button)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the help button, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page, measured on a text field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB); its circular shape is inferred
page just outside the ring: it ends 2.5 pt beyond the edge of the bezel (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)
page at the corner of the box: the ring follows the circle

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The same after Tab in an inactive window, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)
the bezel does not change in an inactive window (spec: help-button, States, inferred)
